1997 Ferrari 456 GT - One of Only 141 RHD Manuals - Gated 6-Speed - Naturally Aspirated V12 - Extensive Service History - Collector owned since 2020.

One of just 141 factory right-hand-drive manual examples produced worldwide, this 1997 Ferrari 456 GT represents a particularly exclusive chapter of Ferrari's V12 grand touring history.

Finished in metallic blue over an Ivory leather interior, this example has travelled just over 37,000 km and is accompanied by its original service books, document wallet, maintenance records and two keys.

Of the approximately 1,548 original 456 GTs produced with the six-speed manual transmission, only 141 were built in right-hand drive. The combination of Ferrari's iconic open-gated manual gearbox, naturally aspirated V12 and beautifully understated Pininfarina design makes this a particularly compelling car for the Ferrari enthusiast.

description:
A superb combination of performance, luxury and everyday practicality, this 2018 Porsche Cayenne delivers genuine Porsche driving dynamics in a refined premium SUV package.

Powered by a strong 3.0-litre turbocharged petrol engine and paired with a smooth 8-speed Tiptronic automatic transmission, the Cayenne offers effortless performance with excellent comfort on longer drives.

The E3 Cayenne introduced a more modern, sharper design with a beautifully finished cabin, excellent road holding and the strong performance expected from Porsche.

A stylish and highly capable prestige SUV that offers the space and comfort of a luxury 4WD while still feeling distinctly sporty to drive.

2008 BMW Z4 M Coupe - Sepang Bronze - Final Production Year - Enthusiast Collector Owned

One of BMW M's most distinctive creations, the E86 Z4 M Coupe was produced in exceptionally limited numbers, with just 4,581 examples manufactured worldwide between 2006 and 2008.

Finished in the seldom-seen Sepang Bronze Metallic, complemented by a beige leather interior with elegant wood trim, this final-year example has been privately owned and cherished by an enthusiast collector since 2018. Now reluctantly offered for sale after eight years of ownership.

What makes the Z4 M Coupe particularly special is its combination of the legendary S54 naturally aspirated engine, M3-derived mechanical components and an unusually intimate driving position. Seated low and far back towards the rear axle, looking down the long bonnet, the driver experiences an almost slingshot-like sensation as the car rotates through corners.

Unlike the more accommodating E46 M3, the Z4 M Coupe was designed as an uncompromising two-seat driver's car, with a short wheelbase, purposeful proportions and a level of mechanical engagement rarely found in modern performance vehicles.

2015 Mercedes-Benz C63 AMG Edition 507 Coupe - 507 Horsepower - SLS AMG Engine Technology - Highly Collectable

One of the most desirable versions of the legendary W204 C63 AMG, the Edition 507 takes its name from its extraordinary 507 horsepower naturally aspirated 6.2-litre V8 engine.

What makes the 507 particularly special is its direct engineering connection to the iconic SLS AMG supercar. Featuring SLS-derived forged engine components, increased power output and distinctive Black Series-inspired styling, the Edition 507 is considerably more than a regular C63 with an appearance package.

With subsequent C63 generations moving to smaller twin-turbocharged V8 engines, the Edition 507 represents a particularly desirable final chapter of AMG's naturally aspirated V8 era.

Considerable expense has been invested in maintaining this M3 to a standard that will appeal to even the most discerning BMW enthusiast. Land Rover Defender 110 Utility - Bespoke TDV6 Automatic Conversion - Extensively Customised - Exceptional Build

An extraordinary amount of time, money and attention to detail has gone into transforming this Defender 110 Utility into something well beyond a standard example.

At the heart of the build is a 2.7-litre TDV6 engine conversion with a matching automatic transmission, including a brand-new crate engine installed at approximately 85,000 km. The extensive work continues throughout the vehicle, from its upgraded suspension, genuine Land Rover external roll cage and 35-inch off-road tyres to its completely bespoke, hand-stitched leather interior.

This is a substantial, carefully considered build featuring premium components from some of the most recognised names in the 4WD industry. Recreating a Defender to this level of specification would require considerable expenditure on parts, engineering, fabrication and specialist workmanship.

The interior has received equally extensive attention, with custom upholstery, premium materials and upgraded technology that significantly enhance the original Defender cabin.
